Questions?Answered.

What does Emelyn actually do?

Emelyn learns your business, watches your industry, and creates posts, carousels, and short videos for each of your channels. She publishes them with your approval or on autopilot, then learns from the results to improve the next ones.

How is Emelyn different from Buffer, Hootsuite, or other schedulers?

Schedulers publish posts you’ve already made. Emelyn makes the posts: she decides what to say, writes it, creates the visuals, and fills your calendar. If you already create all your own content and only need scheduling, a scheduler is the cheaper choice.

I already use ChatGPT or Canva. Why would I need Emelyn?

ChatGPT and Canva help when you sit down and ask. Emelyn works without being asked: she knows your business, keeps track of what’s happening in your industry, prepares new posts every day, and publishes them. You don’t have to start each post yourself.

Can I use Emelyn from ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini?

Yes, with ChatGPT and Claude today. Connect Emelyn as an app in ChatGPT or a connector in Claude, and ask in plain words: schedule posts, check how a channel is doing, or set up a weekly check on competitors. Everything runs through your Emelyn account and your workspace permissions. Gemini is coming soon.

Will the posts sound like my business, or like AI?

Emelyn builds a brand profile from your website: what you sell, who you serve, and how you talk. Every post follows it. You can edit the profile anytime, and edit any post before it goes out.

How does autopilot work? Do I have to approve every post?

You start by approving each post. When you trust what Emelyn creates, switch on autopilot for a channel and she publishes there on her own. You can keep other channels on approval and switch back anytime.

What do I actually need to do each week?

On approval: a few minutes reviewing drafts, from your phone or laptop. On autopilot: nothing, unless you want to check what went out or give Emelyn new direction.

Which social networks does Emelyn work with?

Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Google Business Profile.

How much does it cost, and can I cancel?

Start a free trial on one business, with 1 connected channel and 500 credits. Starter is $29 a month per business, with 3 connected channels and monthly credits for posts, images, and video (extra channels are $5 a month each). Pro is $87 a month for 3 businesses, and Enterprise pricing for more is set with our sales team. Billed monthly; cancel anytime.

Can Emelyn guarantee more customers?

No one honestly can. Results depend on your offer, your audience, and the platforms. Emelyn makes it easy to show up consistently and learn what works.

Hire Emelyn.She starts today.

Questions?Answered.

What does Emelyn actually do?

Emelyn learns your business, watches your industry, and creates posts, carousels, and short videos for each of your channels. She publishes them with your approval or on autopilot, then learns from the results to improve the next ones.

How is Emelyn different from Buffer, Hootsuite, or other schedulers?

Schedulers publish posts you’ve already made. Emelyn makes the posts: she decides what to say, writes it, creates the visuals, and fills your calendar. If you already create all your own content and only need scheduling, a scheduler is the cheaper choice.

I already use ChatGPT or Canva. Why would I need Emelyn?

ChatGPT and Canva help when you sit down and ask. Emelyn works without being asked: she knows your business, keeps track of what’s happening in your industry, prepares new posts every day, and publishes them. You don’t have to start each post yourself.

Can I use Emelyn from ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini?

Yes, with ChatGPT and Claude today. Connect Emelyn as an app in ChatGPT or a connector in Claude, and ask in plain words: schedule posts, check how a channel is doing, or set up a weekly check on competitors. Everything runs through your Emelyn account and your workspace permissions. Gemini is coming soon.

Will the posts sound like my business, or like AI?

Emelyn builds a brand profile from your website: what you sell, who you serve, and how you talk. Every post follows it. You can edit the profile anytime, and edit any post before it goes out.

How does autopilot work? Do I have to approve every post?

You start by approving each post. When you trust what Emelyn creates, switch on autopilot for a channel and she publishes there on her own. You can keep other channels on approval and switch back anytime.

What do I actually need to do each week?

On approval: a few minutes reviewing drafts, from your phone or laptop. On autopilot: nothing, unless you want to check what went out or give Emelyn new direction.

Which social networks does Emelyn work with?

Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Google Business Profile.

How much does it cost, and can I cancel?

Start a free trial on one business, with 1 connected channel and 500 credits. Starter is $29 a month per business, with 3 connected channels and monthly credits for posts, images, and video (extra channels are $5 a month each). Pro is $87 a month for 3 businesses, and Enterprise pricing for more is set with our sales team. Billed monthly; cancel anytime.

Can Emelyn guarantee more customers?

No one honestly can. Results depend on your offer, your audience, and the platforms. Emelyn makes it easy to show up consistently and learn what works.

Hire Emelyn.She starts today.
